_about: Every parameter the seat model depends on. 'source' says where a value comes from; 'confidence' is high (published), medium (derived from published values plus seat counts), low (estimate to be checked against photos or the virtual tour). Edit values here and rerun scripts/build_seats.py.
units: feet; x = across the house (+ toward the even-numbered / Carriage Lobby side), y = up (0 = orchestra floor at row A), z = toward the rear (0 = curtain line)

auditorium_height_ft.source: War Memorial technical specifications (dome centre; the ceiling over the rear Balcony rows is a lower cove, not modelled)

pit_depth_at_centerline_ft.source: War Memorial technical specifications (pit 'width at center line')

seat_counts.source: War Memorial technical specifications p.5; orchestra figure predates the current chart

balcony_rail_to_footlights_ft.source: War Memorial technical specifications (front-of-house lighting rail = Grand Tier front)

seat_width_ft.source: Fits the 113 ft breadth with the 56-seat Balcony Circle rows; typical 21 in seat

balcony_seat_width_ft.source: Balcony rows are 66 seats wide; must fit 113 ft

row_pitch_ft.source: Estimate (35 in). Orchestra A..ZZ then fills 116 ft depth with ~20 ft of rear standing/cross-aisle

aisle_width_ft.source: Estimate; side aisles are the wheelchair ramps

center_aisle_half_ft.source: Estimate (orchestra has a center aisle between 101 and 102)

cross_aisle_ft.source: Estimate; gap between EE and A on both tiers

row_a_z_ft.source: Curtain to apron 4.33 + pit 19.83 + ~1.3 ft rail

rise_total_ft.source: Gentle 1932 parterre rake; standing room behind ZZ needs 7.5 ft under the box ring

curve_center_z_ft.source: Rows are gentle arcs on the seat map

floor_y_ft.source: Soffit with octagonal lights over the orchestra standing room (tour 01c/05c) at ~10.5 ft; floor = soffit + 2.5

rail_radius_x_ft.source: Ring inside the 113 ft breadth with 8 ft deep boxes

rail_radius_z_ft.source: Rear rail at z=71 with the ring centred at z=41

ring_center_z_ft.source: Owner observation: box ring covers about the last ten orchestra rows; rear rail lands between rows R and S (z=71), where the side blocks narrow to two seats

upper_tier._note: Balcony Circle rows AA-EE and Balcony rows A-L, one continuous open tier under the dome (tour 04a/04c). Its front lip sits over Dress Circle row A (owner observation, tour frame from the Grand Tier cross-aisle).

rail_z_ft.source: Lip above Dress Circle row A (z~104) allowing for the rail-to-row offset

floor_y_ft.source: Set so Dress Circle J keeps the full proscenium arch (SF Opera seat photo J-116) with ~9 ft floor-to-soffit at Dress Circle A

balcony_rise_per_row_ft.source: Row L must stay under the ceiling

upstage_reference_z_ft.source: Depth used for the 'how much of the stage width can I see' check

walkure_rock_top_height_above_stage_ft.source: Act III mountaintop set piece height, generic

_calibration: Tier topology and the 80 ft rail distance are from sources/wmoh-technical-specs.pdf and the tour/seat-photo captures in sources/calibration; see sources/CALIBRATION.md.

lower_tier._note: Grand Tier rows AA-EE, a cross-aisle at the 2nd-floor doors, then Dress Circle rows A-L rising to the 3rd-floor doors: one continuous slab (tour frame from the cross-aisle shows both blocks and the Balcony lip over Dress Circle row A).

rail_z_ft.source: Published: balcony rail (FOH lighting rail, on this tier's front) to footlights 80 ft; footlights 4.33 ft behind the curtain line

floor_y_ft.source: About 8 ft over the box level plus slab

cross_aisle_rise_ft.source: Skirted step up from the aisle into Dress Circle A (tour frame)

dress_circle_rise_per_row_ft.source: Row L must reach the 3rd-floor doors

soffit_lip_ahead_of_rail_ft.source: Slab underside reaches just past the rear box row
